limitations: Closed image feasibility trial on one GPU, off any bench (the lab has no text-to-image bench): timing and memory only. No human review of the images, no technical-validity check of the image files, no cloud judge, role or ranking.

Five fixed English prompts at one fixed seed each (two ask for exact text in the image, one for a count of objects, one is photographic, one an illustration; one of the text prompts goes through the layout-box node): correlated requests, not independent capability cases. No generated image, input prompt, model weight, response or machine log is published.

ComfyUI v0.43.0 (commit 426f5eea), the graph of its official template image_moss_image_t2i in API form, without the template's prompt-enhancer branch and without SkipLayerGuidance: 25 steps, CFG 2.5, er_sde sampler, simple scheduler, 1024 x 1024; the layout item through CreateBoundingBoxes and MOSSImageLayoutPrompt (template image_moss_image_t2i_bboxes). Components: the int8 DiT (moss_image_sft_int8_convrot), the Qwen3.5-9B text encoder in w4a8 GPTQ and the FLUX.2 VAE, from Comfy-Org/MOSS-Image at 530a4c94, a repackaging of OpenMOSS-Team/MOSS-Image-SFT; SHA-256 equal to the Hub's LFS ids.
A house image built from the house ComfyUI Dockerfile with ComfyUI moved to v0.43.0 (commit 426f5eea).

Per-image time: wall clock from the request to completion, polled once a second, after one 512 x 512 warm-up request (not counted). Peak memory: the card's memory in use, read every 0.5 s with nvidia-smi (the whole card, not an allocator figure). The first request of the layout item was refused by ComfyUI's input validation (its box list read as a node link) and resubmitted with the boxes wrapped as a value; it is counted once.
The trial ran from about 18:35 to 18:47 UTC on 2 November (minute precision, from the lab's notes).
